faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Landing Gear Truck Beam suitable for Bogie beam for main landing gear?
faq.a: Titanium Landing Gear Truck Beam uses Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address landing gear operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Landing Gear Truck Beam?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Landing Gear Truck Beam require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. landing gear components receive Shot peening Almen 0.008-0.012A inducing compressive residual stress for extended HCF life in aerospace service. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the service environment.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Landing Gear Truck Beam shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements; (4) Surface roughness certification on critical features. FAIR available on request.
